answer: The vertex counter is kept in sparrow and dune exposes each reset. An copycat hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1405 identities would post 4920 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
